home.search: Search a place or paste a pin
home.fixOff: Location is off — search or drop a pin instead
home.fixDenied: Location not allowed — search or drop a pin instead
home.shareBody: Tap the location, then Share → Temen. The check starts on its own.
home.empty: No cores yet. The first one takes about ten seconds.
home.relief: An active flood is reported within 100 km. Full reports are free here while it lasts.
home.footer: Data: JRC Global Surface Water · AWS Terrain · NASA POWER · USGS · ISRIC SoilGrids · MET Norway · GDACS · OpenFreeMap · Google Earth Timelapse
check.reliefBanner: Flood-zone checks are free while GDACS reports an active flood nearby.
check.bedrockBody: No network reached the ground. Check your connection and re-core.
paywall.title: Unseal this core
paywall.singleSub: Full core, questions and PDF for one place
paywall.proSub: Every place, compare, Monsoon Watch, offline
paywall.free: Free always: quick checks, the Rising and the time machine.
paywall.relief: Pro subscribers keep flood-zone checks free for everyone.
paywall.noStore: The store isn't set up in this build.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sources: Where the ground's memory comes from
home.honesty: Never says safe. Always shows sources.
watch.title: Monsoon Watch
watch.lede: Your saved places, checked against the next 24 hours of rain.
watch.empty: Save a core to watch it. Tap Save on any check.
watch.calm: No heavy rain in the next 24 h
watch.pro: Monsoon Watch is part of Pro.
kit.title: Site kit
kit.lede: Things to look at when you stand on the plot. Photos keep where and when they were taken.
kit.camera: Camera access is needed for site photos.
compare.title: Compare
compare.lede: Up to five cores, strata side by side. The laterite mark shows the most notable reading in each row.
paywall.creditsRestored: {n} report(s) restored. Use one on this place below.
paywall.noneFound: No purchases found for this store account.
paywall.noProducts: The store didn't return any products. Check the offering in RevenueCat.
paywall.renew: Subscriptions renew until you cancel in your store account.
paywall.testBuild: This is a test build: purchases go through RevenueCat Test Store and no money moves.
settings.proBody: Every place, compare, Monsoon Watch and offline cores.
settings.freeBody: Quick checks, the Rising and the time machine are free.
settings.noStore: Store: {mode}. Add a RevenueCat key to manage purchases.
settings.aboutBody: Temen reads open satellite and survey records for a point on Earth. It never calls a place safe or unsafe, never claims official boundaries and never predicts floods. The analysis is the open-source ground-memory library (MIT).
tm.failBody: The Timelapse player needs a connection. You can open it in the browser instead.
tm.canSeek: The dial moves the player. Let go on a year to jump there.
tm.noSeek: This player doesn't take a year from outside — scrub with its own controls; the dial marks the year you're reading.
tm.footnote: Imagery is a yearly composite; it shows the land, not official boundaries.
tm.a11y: Satellite time-lapse of this place, 1984 to 2022
report.gone: This core is no longer on this phone.
watch.footnote: Tick marks the IMD "heavy" line: {mm} mm in a day. Background checks run when Android allows, at most hourly.
watch.notPrediction: A forecast, not a flood prediction.
kit.stay: Photos stay on this phone and go into the PDF report with their coordinates and time.
stratum.hint: Shows the numbers behind this reading
